name: io.github.lambdasec/frame-mcp
description: MCP server for the Frame security scanner: scan, verify, fix, exploit, packs and separation logic.

environmentVariables.name: FRAME_LLM_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint for the AI detection, triage, fix and exploit features.

environmentVariables.name: FRAME_LLM_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the LLM endpoint, when the endpoint requires one.

environmentVariables.name: FRAME_LLM_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Model name to request from the LLM endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: FRAME_LLM_REPO_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Repository root the LLM layer resolves relative paths against.
